messages:
alex: Heads up CI failed publishing samplekit again. Typegen produced a regen diff and npm publish bombed with 409.
nina: argh. is this the timestamp drift issue or something else?
alex: looks like timestamp-only change in packages/samplekit/CHANGELOG.md - the generator inserts a generated-at time. CI runs regen on release branch and then enforces zero-diff.
ci-bot: :x: publish failed for @redwood/samplekit@1.4.3 - 409 Conflict: package version already exists
sam: We saw this a while back. The generator uses Date.now() when building changelog header, so every CI run can flip that field even if code unchanged.
ryan: Could we set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in CI to the commit time? Many reproducible builds follow that.
nina: agree. Short-term: set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from `git show -s --format=%ct $COMMIT_SHA`.
alex: I can add that to the regen job env. Also propose adding a `--stable-timestamps` flag to the changelog generator so devs can opt-in locally.
sam: Another nuisance: sample-app e2e flaked in the same build because publish-bot retried auth and the tests expect a new package to be available immediately. The 409 made it worse.
ryan: For publish-bot we should make retries use exponential backoff + deterministic jitter (based on commit hash) so test timing is more predictable.
nina: Good call. Also: add a lightweight pre-publish check that detects "regen-only diffs". Script idea: run regen, run `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT`, and for any modified changelog files, run `git diff --unified=0 path | grep -E "^\+## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ - [0-9T:-Z]+$"` to see if only header timestamp changed. If only that, allow publish if on release branch.
alex: sounds pragmatic. Let's be careful to log and annotate so we don't accidentally skip real changelog edits.
sam: I'll add a check that ensures there are no other contextual changes in the chunk (lines added other than the timestamp header).
ryan: Long-term: change generator to produce changelog entries deterministically from commit metadata (author/date) and only insert generated-timestamp when content changes; plus a changelog lint rule blocking hand-editing of auto sections.
nina: Also add an integration test in CI that runs regen twice in a clean checkout and asserts zero diffs. That should catch regressions early.
alex: I'll open two PRs: 1) CI: set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH + regen flag 2) publish guard script + publish-bot retry backoff tweak.
sam: I'll add the regen integration test and update the generator doc.
ci-bot: Logs: https://ci.example.com/build/2780056789/logs (artifact: packages/samplekit/CHANGELOG.diff)
ryan: tagging @devex for follow-up and @eng-release for publish-bot change.
alex: thanks team, aim to have hotfix PRs by EOD.
